title: Ecosystem Hub
subtitle: Digital employees, connectors and skills — enable what you need
sourceDesc: Once your backend URL is set, employees, connectors, skills and stats are fetched from the cloud first (updatable anytime on the server); falls back to local assets when unset or unreachable.
enabledConnector: Enabled "{name}" — it now appears in the chat "+" menu. {env}
disabledConnector: Disabled "{name}" — hidden from the chat "+" menu.
envRequiredHint: Click "Configure" and fill in these variables before connecting: {vars}.
envNoneHint: No extra keys needed — click it in the "+" menu to connect.
enableOnlyMenuHint: Enabling only adds it to the “+” menu; configure credentials and connect in a session before its tools become callable

dialog.subtitle: Configure / authorize in place
dialog.oauthAuthorizeHint: This service uses browser OAuth. Click below to authorize in-app; the token is stored encrypted and survives restarts.
dialog.oauthAuthorized: Authorized in this app (token stored encrypted; no re-auth after restart). Test the connection now.
dialog.oauthSelfAuth: This service completes its own OAuth flow after startup (follow its prompts); the app does not manage its tokens.
dialog.pasteKeyHint: Create and copy a key/token in the official console, paste it below and test the connection.
dialog.manualHint: No auto-launch info for this service. Fill in the credentials required by its official spec below and save, then deploy it per the official docs and add it under Local Services.
dialog.openMcpJsonFailed: Failed to open the config file: {error}
dialog.readyHint: Launch info complete — connect with one click.
dialog.connFailed: Connection failed — check the values and retry
dialog.enableNote: Enabling only controls "+" menu visibility; the connection happens when you click here

custom.title: Add a custom MCP server
custom.subtitle: Fill in what the target service's docs specify; once validated and connected it is saved on this machine automatically
custom.nameHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen only; must differ from existing servers or the old config is overwritten
custom.envHint: Secrets are written only to the local config file and never echoed back to the UI or logs
custom.headersHint: Leave headers empty for OAuth-based remote servers — authorization happens in the browser on connect
custom.saveNote: Once validated, click “Save & connect”: a successful handshake writes the local config and it reconnects automatically afterwards
custom.savedNotice: Added and saved locally: {name} (manage it under Local services)
custom.help: Where to get the config: check the target MCP server's official docs or the JSON config from its MCP marketplace, then copy the command/URL and credentials here
custom.errNameChars: Server name may only contain letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen
custom.errNameTaken: Name {name} already exists — pick another, otherwise the existing config is overwritten
custom.errCommandRequired: The local-process transport needs a command (e.g. npx)
custom.errUrlRequired: The remote transport needs a server URL
custom.errUrlScheme: The server URL must start with http:// or https://
custom.errEnvLine: Line {lines} of the environment variables is malformed; expected KEY=VALUE
custom.errHeaderLine: Line {lines} of the headers is malformed; expected KEY: VALUE
